theme.archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy)
theme.description: A highly productive, 'Linear-esque' SaaS dashboard optimized for door-to-door sales (vente à domicile) and field-service planning (chantiers). It prioritizes clarity, minimal friction, and high data density to eliminate double-entry. Crisp borders, subtle shadows, and distinct semantic colors.

rules: Use 'Outfit' for all headings. Never use 'Inter' for headings.
Use 'Inter' for body text, form inputs, and data tables.
Apply tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headings (text-3xl and up).
Use capitalized, widely spaced (tracking-[0.1em] to tracking-[0.2em]) tiny text (text-xs) for table headers, labels, and overlines.
Ensure strong font-weight contrast (e.g., font-semibold for entity names, font-normal for secondary data).

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist approach. Use very subtle ambient shadows for cards (shadow-sm) and more pronounced shadows (shadow-xl) for floating elements like Modals, Popovers, and Dropdowns. Focus primarily on 1px borders for structure.
visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp or slightly rounded edges. Use rounded-lg or rounded-xl maximum. Standardize on 1px border-slate-200 for cards, tables, and inputs.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly. Apply backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 to sticky headers, floating action bars, or top-level navigation to maintain context while scrolling.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: All interactive elements must provide immediate feedback. Table rows should change background (hover:bg-slate-50). Buttons should scale slightly (active:scale-[0.98]) and change color or opacity.

layouts.general: Responsive desktop-first admin layout. Fixed left sidebar for main navigation. Top header for global search, notifications, and user profile. Main content area has a max-width and generous padding (p-6 to p-10).
layouts.dashboard_kpi: Bento-grid style (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4). Cards with metric, trend indicator (+/- %), and a sparkline or small chart.
layouts.data_tables: Full-width Shadcn tables for Ventes and Clients. Include sticky headers, column sorting, and row actions (dropdown menus at the end of each row).
layouts.kanban_board: Horizontal scrollable container taking full height. 3 distinct columns: 'À planifier' (To Schedule), 'En cours' (In Progress), 'Terminé' (Completed). Cards should be compact, showing client name, service, and priority.
layouts.calendar: Full-height grid layout with weekly and monthly views. Scheduled projects should appear as solid color blocks. Use a robust calendar library or a custom CSS grid if simple.
layouts.forms_and_modals: Use Shadcn Sheets (slide-out side panels) for complex forms like 'Nouvelle Vente' (New Sale) or 'Détails Client' to keep the user in the context of their current view. Use Dialogs for quick confirmations.

motion.transitions: Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform). Do not use transition-all.
motion.interactions: Hover states on table rows, subtle scale-down on buttons when pressed.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-in (opacity 0 to 1, translate-y-2 to 0) for dashboard widgets and table rows.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. Gray text (text-muted) must be dark enough against white/gray backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-1) on all inputs, selects, and buttons.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons. Ensure modal overlays trap focus.

login_background.description: Modern house exterior, representing home improvement and door-to-door sales. Use on the left side of the split-screen login page.

avatar_placeholder.description: Professional avatar placeholder for the current user profile.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a unified Sidebar layout with navigation items: Tableau de bord, Ventes, Chantiers (Kanban), Planning (Calendrier), Clients. Ensure all text is in French.
For the Login view, create a 50/50 split screen (image on one side, login form on the other).
Use Shadcn UI for all structural and interactive components (Tables, Dialogs, Sheets, Select, Forms).
For the Kanban board (Chantiers), implement a drag-and-drop interface (using something like dnd-kit or react-beautiful-dnd if possible, or build a simple state-based clickable UI to move items).
For the Calendar (Planning), use 'react-big-calendar' or build a functional custom grid view. It must visualize projects scheduled on specific dates.

Crucial Workflow: The 'Nouvelle Vente' (New Sale) form should automatically create a client if it doesn't exist, and upon signing/validating, it should automatically push a record into the 'À planifier' (To Schedule) status of the Kanban board, preventing double-entry.
Include realistic mock data (clients, sales, projects) to populate the dashboard, sales list, and kanban board immediately on load.
Implement a global export function (CSV/Excel mockup) as requested in the prompt.
Add `data-testid` attributes to all major interactive elements (buttons, form inputs, navigation links, table rows) for robust testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: left; } is correct).
Do not use generic simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-transform, transition-opacity) - NEVER transition-all.
Never use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Ensure responsive design: Sidebar should collapse into a hamburger menu on mobile devices.
